summary: Single-sector earthquake: Materials -4.03% on a gold (-3.78%) and silver (-6.25%) rout, triggered by the US-Iran peace deal and a hawkish Warsh Fed debut, dragged the ASX 200 -0.92% to 8,828.70 even as US equities rallied Thursday. Capital rotated cleanly into defensives (Health Care +3.51% on CSL +7.62%) and domestic cyclicals; Smart Money saw Multiline Insurance surge to #1. Breadth was narrow (XJO Adv/Dec 0.76:1) but 20-day highs beat lows 33-9, confirming miner-led, not broad, damage. RBA held 4.35% on 16 June; next meeting 11 August.
